messages.text: Are the Nexus S1 in stock?
Read the nexus s1 10th s page

You can order it, Nicholas, $699 for the US plug, but it isn't on the shelf. S1 stock is batch 2, still in transit to the warehouse, so a new one ships once it lands rather than right away.

You can follow that shipment here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

The E. plug is out of stock; US and UK are the ones you can order.

Still planning to wait on the B30, or do you want me to set one aside now?

Understood. Shop···· is still on track for November 7, 30 TH/s with the Power Kit in the same box.

Once it's running, tell me what you see on the dashboard and we can talk about whether a second S1 or something bigger makes sense. No rush.
Before you go, one thing: you said you're waiting on the B30, so what had you checking S1 stock tonight?
Really like the one I have
Good to hear. What is it about it, the noise level, the setup, or just that it's been reliable?

Glad it's all running well. Nothing else needed from you tonight, and your B30 is still set for November 7.

Enjoy the weekend, Nicholas.
